import logging
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request
from app.auth import require_user
from app.services import customers

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
router = APIRouter()


@router.get("/v2/customers/{customer_id}")
def get_customer(customer_id: int, request: Request, user=Depends(require_user)):
    customer = customers.get(customer_id)
    logger.info("Customer %s viewed from %s", customer_id, request.client.host)
    return customer
